description: Portal arc part 2/2: the portal opens, 'portal itu nyata!', photo mode, he walks in, and behind it is only a bar: 'oh, order minum doang guys'. Cuts: T t 3085.00-3086.20 = local 0.60-1.80 -> output 0.00-1.20; A t 3060.50-3064.80 = local 3.00-7.30 -> output 1.20-5.50; B t 3099.95-3104.20 = local 8.50-12.75 -> output 5.50-9.75; C t 3105.00-3107.80 = local 13.95-16.75 -> output 9.75-12.55; D t 3110.90-3113.95 = local 17.95-21.00 -> output 12.55-15.60; E t 3133.00-3136.90 = local 22.20-26.10 -> output 15.60-19.50; F t 3164.00-3172.40 = local 27.30-35.70 -> output 19.50-27.90; G t 3464.20-3467.60 = local 36.90-40.30 -> output 27.90-31.30. Beats in stream order: frame-0 teaser (h3 51:25, the ring crackling up close, 1.2 s); he walks up to the ring (h3 51:00-51:05, silent); 'we did it bro, oh my god guys' (51:40-51:44); 'I was here' x5 (51:45-51:48); 'portal itu nyata, portal itu nyata' (51:51-51:54); photo mode in front of the ring 'portal itu nyata, portal mengerikan itu nyata' (52:13-52:17); selfie poses and he walks in 'masuk, masuk, masuk!' (52:44-53:12); the letdown behind it: the club, 'oh, order minum doang guys' (57:44-57:47). Word timings from short-window faster-whisper medium (VAD on, and off for silent stretches). Viewer names, platform and brand names are not in any cut. CUT: the 4-star chase and the arrest (h3 39:40-50:50, armed guards), the club's dance floor and the screen-share with a platform name at 57:38-58:20 (this cut is the game window only, 57:44-57:47), 'what the f' at 53:48. The permanent chopper bike (piece 4) is left out to keep the arc short. Music: the club may play licensed-sounding tracks; the cut is 3.4 s, check by ear. No guns, gore or revealing outfits in frame (the club cut shows one NPC from behind in a pink top). Main 31.30 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first).
